5e8748d9ad36: What's new in 4.0 rc.1 · translationCore 4 Help
a96ec9e959f4: All exports start from Check › Community Checking › Open → › Export. When the file is saved, the panel says "Saved <file name>".
67aa2c44b541: Bible book: Export PDF, USFM, aligned, USFM, plain and Scripture Burrito (.zip). See Export a book as PDF, Export a book as USFM and Export a project as a Scripture Burrito.
b663fadf76fa: Open Bible Stories: Export PDF (with or without pictures), Story Markdown (.zip) and Scripture Burrito (.zip). See Export stories as PDF or Markdown.
5c311b0da168: A book with nothing drafted isn't printed. tC4 tells you to draft at least one verse first.
1b8873235b0e: + Add a project › Import a project makes a new project from a translationCore 3 project, USFM files or a Scripture Burrito. See Import a project.
eec56cdf9e00: The review shows the books, three checks (License, Details, Missing verses) and what carries over.
b660107cca1a: A missing language code or a Bible name already in use must be fixed before you can import.
0295cc7df56b: Damaged files are refused with a reason and a code, and nothing is created. See Messages that protect your project.
4c42324b66cb: The new card has an Imported badge.
87260e0867ce: Settings on the card: click Settings on a project's Home card. See Project settings.
b10f6be5a04a: A cleaner top bar. Cards say "Only on this computer" or where the project is shared. See The Home screen.
39343cdc0766: New books open in Understand, so you read before you draft. After that a book reopens in the mode you used last. See The three modes.
ded025843f53: English helps v91 come with the app, so a new project needs no download. See What comes with the app.
2b5f376dd396: Moving between a Bible and a stories project no longer confuses their notes and words. See Check a story.
5d05eacc33de: Page setup for printing: spacing and paper size for Bible books, and picture layout for stories. See Community Checking preview and Story preview and export.
26e2986aaafd: Window › Reload (Ctrl+R) brings the app back without quitting. A screen that can't be drawn shows "This screen could not be shown." with Back to Home. See If the app closed unexpectedly.
75adae5584b1: Resume returns to the last mode, including the checking tool you were using. See Resume where you left off.
5c903e40591d: Check for updates offers only the texts your books need. A New Testament project isn't offered the Hebrew text. See Update scripture texts.
be04ef059d1e: Changing the checking language keeps the checks that still match. The rest come back as work; nothing is deleted. See Change the checking language.
347faab50e96: translationCore 3 imports ask whether to look up the resource versions on Door43 or use the ones on this computer. See Import a project.
7a4346054e2e: After you join verses into a span, the book's percentage can drop, and the Resume banner can still name the old verse.
13df6adf096a: The "… was imported" message doesn't close by itself. Close it with its ✕.
344b508cb778: In USFM exports, the \h, \toc and \mt lines carry the book code (for example TIT), not the book name.
b72b7d03c227: On Linux, the save window's Save and Cancel buttons can be off-screen. Press Enter to save, or Esc to cancel.
b026d94dc061: The same language can be named two ways, for example "Español (Latinoamérica)" in lists and "Spanish (Latin American)" in sentences.
